title: Marcos, MILF leaders meet in Malacañang

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. met with leaders of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) on Wednesday in Malacañang, Presidential Peace Adviser Sec. Mel Senen Sarmiento said Thursday. In a Facebook post, Sarmiento said he joined the President in the meeting with the MILF leaders, which was conducted after the President met with the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC), also held in Malacañang. He said the President met with MILF chairman Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim, MILF Peace Implementing Panel chair Mohagher Iqbal, Atty. Sha Elijah “Lai” Dumama-Alba, and Engr. Mohajirin Ali.
